description: Split a long document (plain text or Markdown) into readable chunks for retrieval (RAG): at headings, paragraphs, sentences and words in that order; Markdown chunks keep their heading path. Each chunk carries its character offsets.

overlap.description: Characters repeated from the previous chunk. Default a tenth of the size.

size.description: Largest chunk in characters, 100 to 20000. Default 1000.

name: chunk_text
title: Chunk text
